verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents monitors that check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP. Marketing copy says the product alerts you to compliance violations, and the Monitors page lets you investigate violations and see status (healthy, violations found, connection errors). Nothing shows these alerts reaching Slack, email or a ticketing system, so the 'where I work' part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: documented Slack/email/ticketing delivery of control-failure or drift alerts, documentation of the remediation context included in alerts, configuration-drift-specific alerting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, control failures and configuration drift alert me where I work — Slack, email, or ticketing — with enough context to fix the finding

citations.quote: Thoropass collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations
Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.
From this screen, you can quickly assess system health, investigate violations, and manage your audit readiness.
